source: Gilroy City Code Chapter 30 Zoning Ordinance (codepublishing.com/CA/Gilroy) and Gilroy 2040 General Plan Land Use Element (cityofgilroy.org/DocumentCenter/View/11311/02_Land-Use). See also: https://www.codepublishing.com/CA/Gilroy/html/Gilroy30/Gilroy30.html
notes: Density values are derived from the Gilroy Municipal Code Chapter 30 and 2040 General Plan. Min/max values reflect the intended average density ranges stated in each district article. For commercial/industrial zones without residential use, density is 0. Downtown Specific Plan districts (DHD, DED, CD, GD, TD, CCA) have minimum density requirements for residential components of mixed-use or standalone residential projects.

A1.description: Agricultural District. Intended for agricultural uses with an average density of less than 1 dwelling unit per 20 acres (0.05 du/ac). Maximum 1 dwelling unit per lot.

RR.description: Rural Residential District. Intended for an average density of 1 dwelling unit per 2.5 acres (0.4 du/ac). Maximum 1 dwelling unit per lot.

RH.description: Residential Hillside District. For areas with 10-30% average slope. Density determined by slope-density formula, up to a maximum of approximately 1-4 du/ac depending on slope. No construction allowed where slope exceeds 30%.

R1.description: Single-Family Residential District. Intended for single-family detached dwellings at an average density of 3 to 7.25 du/ac. Maximum density is 1 single-family detached unit per lot.

R2.description: Two-Family Residential District. Intended for an average density of 3 to 9 du/ac. Maximum density is 1 dwelling unit per 4,000 sq ft of land, up to 2 units per lot.

R3.description: Medium Density Residential District. Intended for an average density of 8 to 16 du/ac. Maximum density is 1 dwelling unit per 2,722 sq ft of lot area.

R4.description: High Density Residential District. Intended for group dwellings and apartments at an average density of 20 to 30 du/ac.

C1.description: Neighborhood Commercial District. Primarily for neighborhood-serving commercial uses. Residential not a primary permitted use.

C2.description: Central Commercial District. For central/downtown commercial uses. Standalone residential not permitted.

C3.description: Shopping Center Commercial District. Residential units may be allowed on 2nd or 3rd floors with a conditional use permit, but no defined residential density standard.

HC.description: Highway Commercial District. For highway-oriented commercial uses. No residential density standard.

GC.description: Gateway Commercial District. For gateway commercial uses along major corridors. No residential density standard.

DHD.description: Downtown Historic District (Downtown Specific Plan). Residential only as part of mixed-use development. Minimum residential density of 20 du/ac.

DED.description: Downtown Expansion District (Downtown Specific Plan). Residential only as part of mixed-use development. Minimum residential density of 20 du/ac.

CD.description: Cannery District (Downtown Specific Plan). Allows standalone residential and mixed-use. Standalone residential must develop at 20 to 40 du/ac.

GD.description: Gateway District (Downtown Specific Plan). Allows standalone residential and mixed-use. Standalone residential at a maximum of 30 du/ac. Minimum density of 20 du/ac.

TD.description: Transitional District (Downtown Specific Plan). Allows commercial, mixed-use, and standalone residential. Standalone residential at a maximum of 20 du/ac.

CCA.description: Civic/Cultural Arts District (Downtown Specific Plan). Residential allowed as part of mixed-use. Minimum density of 20 du/ac for residential component. Maximum FAR 2.5.

CI.description: Campus Industrial District. For campus-style industrial and office park uses. Residential not permitted.

CM.description: Commercial Industrial District. For mixed commercial and light industrial uses. Residential not permitted.

M1.description: Limited Industrial District. For light manufacturing, warehousing, and related uses. Residential not permitted.

M2.description: General Industrial District. For large-scale manufacturing, assembly, storage, distribution, and wholesaling. Residential not permitted.

A-1.description: Agricultural District. Intended for agricultural uses with an average density of less than 1 dwelling unit per 20 acres (0.05 du/ac).

C-1.description: Neighborhood Commercial District. Primarily for neighborhood-serving commercial uses. Residential not a primary permitted use.

C-3.description: Shopping Center Commercial District. Residential units may be allowed on 2nd or 3rd floors with a conditional use permit.

Cannery District.description: Cannery District (Downtown Specific Plan). Allows standalone residential and mixed-use. Standalone residential must develop at 20 to 40 du/ac.

Civic/Cultural Arts Disctrict.description: Civic/Cultural Arts District (Downtown Specific Plan). Residential allowed as part of mixed-use. Minimum density of 20 du/ac.

Expansion District.description: Downtown Expansion District (Downtown Specific Plan). Residential only as part of mixed-use development. Minimum residential density of 20 du/ac.

Gateway District.description: Gateway District (Downtown Specific Plan). Allows standalone residential and mixed-use at a maximum of 30 du/ac. Minimum density of 20 du/ac.

Glen Loma Ranch Special District.description: Glen Loma Ranch Special District. Master-planned community with a mix of single-family and multi-family residential.

Hecker Pass Special District.description: Hecker Pass Special District. Rural area with agricultural and rural residential uses; very low density.

Historic District.description: Downtown Historic District (Downtown Specific Plan). Residential only as part of mixed-use development. Minimum residential density of 20 du/ac.

M-1.description: Limited Industrial District. For light manufacturing, warehousing, and related uses. Residential not permitted.

M-2.description: General Industrial District. For large-scale manufacturing, assembly, storage, distribution. Residential not permitted.

ND.description: Neighborhood District. Neighborhood-scale uses; density per specific plan.

OS.description: Open Space. Parks, recreation areas, and natural open space; no residential.

PF.description: Public Facilities. Public and institutional uses including schools, government buildings; no residential.

PO.description: Professional Office. Professional office and administrative uses; no residential as primary use.

R-1.description: Single-Family Residential District. Single-family detached dwellings at 3 to 7.25 du/ac.

R-2.description: Two-Family Residential District. Average density of 3 to 9 du/ac. Up to 2 units per lot.

R-3.description: Medium Density Residential District. Average density of 8 to 16 du/ac.

R-4.description: High Density Residential District. Group dwellings and apartments at 20 to 30 du/ac.

Transitional District.description: Transitional District (Downtown Specific Plan). Allows commercial, mixed-use, and standalone residential at a maximum of 20 du/ac.
